answer: Sybil farms mint empty wallets faster than work can land. To hold a ballot, an identity parks 46 POA in a harbor customs bond and mills one umber assay wafer on a one-use marble press keyed to the epoch seed. Two draft readings, at least 9.5 hours apart and signed by distinct weighmasters, prove the same body stayed. A clone needs its own press and unused weighmasters. Peers recompute the press serial from the bond ledger and drop a reused press or crossed weighmaster. A missed draft or two wafers from one press burns 61% of the bond; a weighmaster signing two wafers in one epoch loses 10 POA.
